text:
Sara L: Quick change: roadmap demo moved to after lunch. Need to push CEO intro 5 mins earlier and get captions on for the live stream. PTZ cam was drifting during rehearsal. Can someone lock camera and confirm captions source? @Tom (AV)
Tom (AV): Copy. I'm locking PTZ to preset 2 now. Also swapping live captions to the backup transcription service. If captions fail, we'll enable manual captioning (Nora, can you standby?).
Tom (AV): Steps to switch captions:
```
1) OBS -> Tools -> Captioning Plugin
2) Source: Transcriber-Primary -> Transcriber-Backup
3) Restart caption websocket (Tools -> Restart Caption WS)
4) Post status in thread
```
Priya: I'm seeing intermittent audio dropouts when the presenter moves off mic. Remind presenters to use the lav. Also flagged low caption latency earlier.
Ben - Eng: I can add an alert to the stream routing for audio level < -18dB. Will deploy now (will be quick).
Infra-bot: Stream Monitor: caption latency spike at 2026-03-23T16:04:11Z, 3.2s.
Tom (AV): Caption switch done to Transcriber-Backup. Confirming captions are live on the staging player.
Nora (Comms): On standby for manual captions. If backup drops, I'll start manual captioning in Google Slides speaker notes.
Sara L: Thanks. Tom, can you also toggle the recording redundancy? We want cloud + local in case of upload issues.
Tom (AV): Enabling dual-record now. Cloud record will remain primary; local fallback recording path: /mnt/recordings/allhands_1862239999_local.mkv. I'll announce when both are running.
Priya: Also heads-up, slide deck B has an embedded video that may cause a black-screen flip when switching scenes. Jamie can you preload the video source as a separate scene?
Ben - Eng: I've pushed the audio-level alert; will roll back if it spikes false positives.
Tom (AV): Dual-record active. Cloud status: OK. Local recording started: allhands_1862239999_local.mkv. Notifying ops channel.
Sara L: Great. After CEO intro, we'll do 3 roadmap questions. Post them here with :one:, :two:, :three:. Nora please capture the live caption notes and link to the recording afterwards.
Nora (Comms): :one: How are we prioritizing Dedicated capacity features for mid-market customers?
Priya: :two: Any change to the SLA for Hosted API during high-load experiments?
Ben - Eng: :three: What's the plan for replicating low-latency KV cache across regions?
Infra-bot: Uploader: local recording uploaded to s3://redwood-recordings/allhands/1862239999/allhands_1862239999_local.mkv (status: success).
Sara L: Perfect. We'll surface those in the live Q&A. If anyone spots the PTZ drifting again, drop a quick note and Tom will re-lock. Thanks team! :clap:
